provider.name: USDA PLANTS Database
provider.organization_type: national plant taxonomy, nomenclature, standardized-symbol, distribution, wetland-indicator, invasive-status, plant-characteristics, mapping, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: The USDA PLANTS Database is a national reference for plant names, accepted taxa, synonyms, standardized symbols, classification, common names, distributions across U.S. states and territories, wetland indicator statuses, invasive and noxious designations, plant characteristics, maps, and downloadable data.
institutional_context: Former National Plant Data Center and successor data-management teams
Federal, state, territorial, tribal, academic, herbarium, and conservation partners

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting USDA PLANTS documentation, organization, taxonomy, symbols, synonyms, classifications, distributions, wetland indicators, invasive and noxious statuses, plant characteristics, maps, APIs, downloads, schemas, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: USDA, NRCS, USDA PLANTS, official federal and state legal sources, source floras, herbaria, wetland lists, noxious-weed authorities, official releases, and cited external authorities remain authoritative for names, symbols, distributions, statuses, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
